_about: Season calendar, standings, discipline carry-over, weather, attendance and between-match fitness. Read by src/sim/schedule.ts, standings.ts, playoffs.ts, season.ts and league.ts.

calendar._about: Double round-robin: rounds 1-15 in weeks 1-15, a two-week break, rounds 16-30 in weeks 18-32, then three playoff weeks.

scheduleSearch._about: Venue balancing search: no club plays more than maxVenueStreak home (or away) league matches in a row. Iterations and restarts only bound the search.

playoffs._about: Top six qualify; seeds 1 and 2 skip the quarter-finals (3 v 6, 4 v 5). The higher seed hosts every match.

injuries._about: When false, an injury picked up this week starts counting down at the end of next week, so a one-week injury misses one match.

weather._about: Weather odds by calendar-week band. League play runs April to November; snow is kept for the playoff weeks.

attendance._about: Share of capacity: base plus weighted home fan mood, market size, stadium condition and the visitors' squad quality, plus a playoff bonus and a little noise, clamped.

condition._about: Players lose condition in proportion to minutes played and recover a share of the gap to full fitness every week (break weeks included).
